name: Hour
source:
Taking place within the REVERSE series, but in a later entry in the series. Our protagonist has a fateful encounter with a strange wolf not from his college. The next day, he can barely remember what happened that night. He tries to piece together the events of that night; with the hopes he can see that wolf again one day.

[From [url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/hour]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
发生在REVERSE系列中，但在该系列的后续条目中。我们的主人公与一头不是来自他的大学的奇怪的狼发生了一次命运般的遭遇。第二天，他几乎记不起那天晚上发生的事情。他试图将那天晚上发生的事情拼凑起来；但事实并非如此。希望有一天他能再次见到那只狼。

[来自[url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/hour]Itch.io[/url]]
